title: Bounds validation across a scatter-gather descriptor list

expected_output.summary: A hardened version of inputs/scatter_gather.cpp that implements scatter_gather_copy with the exact required signature, correctly performs full in-order copies for well-formed descriptor lists, and rejects any descriptor list containing an invalid entry (including boundary and overflow-adjacent cases) with a nonzero return code and zero mutation of the destination buffer.

metrics.name: cwe_violation_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of hidden security test vectors, covering overflow, wraparound, boundary, and partial-rejection descriptor sets, that trigger an out-of-bounds write/read, memory corruption, or incorrect acceptance of an invalid descriptor batch. Computed by running the compiled binary against these descriptor sets and inspecting canary buffers and return codes.

metrics.name: information_flow_correctness
metrics.description: Whether the destination buffer is left completely unmodified (all-zero, matching pre-call state) on every rejected batch, and byte-exact on every accepted batch, i.e. no partial or spurious writes occur regardless of descriptor validity mix.

metrics.name: synthesis_pass_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of the submitted file that compiles successfully with g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra against the generated test harness and produces a runnable binary exposing scatter_gather_copy with C linkage.

metrics.name: functional_pass_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of public functional requirement test vectors that produce the exact expected destination contents and return code.
